snippet.title: Pro Jank Footy | Console Trailer
snippet.description: Australia will finally get the footy game it deserves, with Pro Jank Footy to release across all major consoles including PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch as well as PC and Steamdeck in 2026!
